correctness.rationale: Exact orbit-barycenter PL model follows from constant orbit barycentric coordinates; odd r forbids singleton hyperedge orbits; compatible transversal phases have disjoint r-block supports. In top dimension each codimension-one ridge determines its unique missing r-block, making the signed integral boundary block diagonal over perfect partitions. Each block kernel is a tensor of Z-augmentation lattices. Centralizer stabilizers act by coordinate flips and block swaps, with the latter inducing the top orientation sign. k=1 and other boundaries are included, without extending finite checks to infinity.

value.rationale: An infinite naturally parameterized family of geometric symmetry-fixed spaces is identified with explicit phase inflations. Top integral homology and full W-lattice—including nontrivial block-orientation signs—are classified uniformly, and fixed topology differs sharply from the top triviality of the underlying uninflated matching complex. This structural integral equivariant result is neither a table recomputation nor just a rank already provided by the classical inflation theorem.
